ENOXAPARIN_VTE_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW.html.snippet: PREVENTIHS NCT01573169: Paciaroni M et al. Eur Neurol 2020;83:566-575. VTE prophylaxis after acute intracerebral haemorrhage, enoxaparin 4000 IU SC/day (n=38) vs mechanical/standard prophylaxis (n=35). Primary symptomatic or asymptomatic VTE at 10 days: 6/38 (15.8%) vs 7/35 (20.0%). Per-arm counts + denominators AACT-verified. Small single-trial; comparator is mechanical prophylaxis (not placebo drug).
